# BMP reduced-candidate full matrix

Candidate: `candidate5-two-layouts`; parent: the original frozen baseline at `945da378a907bb7c4fec1f432d02d320c9d2a462`. All ratios are **candidate/baseline**, with less than 1 meaning fewer cycles.

All eight commands returned zero. Expected rows per binary are decode 120, consuming RGBA 218, borrowed RGBA 218, and repository 24. The 115 strict-watcher checks were clear. Timing used five median batches of 20 ms on CPU 2. Decode and borrowed ran baseline then candidate; consuming and repository ran candidate then baseline.

## Selection recommendation

The two target transformations improve their intended formats, but this reduced source does not establish that the material unchanged-format losses are resolved. Recommend restoring original BMP production at the agreed end of this selection loop, retaining useful regression coverage and all experiment evidence. No new candidate or optional timing is proposed. Final selection is recorded separately in `EXPERIMENTS.md`.

Unchanged decode controls have geometric ratio 1.046324, including RGB555/565/333 at 1.065486/1.065651/1.087146; all eight cases in each group lose. Consuming controls are much closer overall, but individual groups and cases remain slower beyond the reference change. Native continuing to beat image is not sufficient to clear this native-regression gate.
